description: Permissions for the main AllMyAgents window: native open/save file dialogs (the folder picker that replaces the old PowerShell popup), opening external links in the OS browser, the auto-updater (check/download/install, always behind an explicit click), and executing the dev hub command. NOTE: in dev the Node hub is actually spawned by the Rust host in setup() via std::process (not gated by capabilities); the shell:allow-execute scope below simply also permits the webview to launch that same command if we ever move the spawn to the frontend — hence two entries, a Windows one (pnpm is a .cmd shim so it goes through cmd) and a POSIX one (pnpm is exec'd directly), matching spawn_hub_dev() in lib.rs.
